description: Scan all files in a directory on disk for security vulnerabilities. Pass a directory path — reads files from filesystem. Returns security score (A-F) and findings. Results may be truncated for large projects — check fileRanking in JSON output for top files. Example: scan_directory({path: './src'})

baseline.description: Path to a previous scan JSON output file for baseline comparison (new/fixed/unchanged findings)

format.description: Output format: markdown (human) or json (machine-readable for agents)

name: scan_directory
